records.subject: Welcome aboard, Timber Collective
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days since signup with zero product activity: no first project, no invite sent, no milestone. No reply to the welcome email [email:d9ae3017] and no tickets filed, so no signal of engagement or intent. Silent accounts rarely self-start within 8 days, though Pro plan purchase gives some intent.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Checking in after your welcome note last week. If it's helpful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. And a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, so Timber Collective can work in there together.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
